verdict.rationale: LocalAI calls itself an "open runtime", and several evidence items come from a public GitHub repository (github.com/mudler/LocalAI), which suggests the source can be read. However, no item names an actual open-source license or confirms the full source is published under one. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g. MIT/Apache), first-party statement that the full source is openly licensed, independent corroboration of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Text, voice, vision, images, video, 3D and agents, from one open runtime.
It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
